latest_release.name: bug fixes, form and routing experience improvements
latest_release.body:
v3.0.2 - 2026-03-15
Fixed

Fixed rich text editor style issues

Fixed menu area not scrollable issue

Fixed blank page issue when opening special routes

Fixed WebSocket reconnection issue

Fixed incorrect handling of special dynamic route parameters

Fixed dynamic form validation errors when using ArtTable with ElForm

Fixed parent menu being hidden when child menus are hidden

Fixed static routes redirecting to homepage after page refresh

Fixed art-table props inheritance issue

Fixed menu layout not restoring to desktop mode after switching from PC → mobile → PC

Optimized

Added data sanitization before form submission in ArtForm and ArtSearchBar to prevent invalid fields from being sent to the backend
